text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, I will take on the
Twinkle Series with Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suppressing my racing heart, I went
to deliver the news to her—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Teacher. I've gathered everyone's
submitted assignments on the desk for you."

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
You're a lifesaver~! But I'm so sorry...
Especially when you're so busy before your debut...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, don't worry about it.
If it's just lending a hand, I'm happy to join in anytime!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as expected of our honor student!
Take care of my classroom duties for me too, will ya~?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes, of cou...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? What are you talking about!
Vodka!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't scowl like that.
You'll ruin your "honor student" look, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! Why don't you drop the "delinquent act" yourself?
You're just gonna use your free time for self-training anyway, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wh-what... As if that's true!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Vodka-san. Perfect timing.
There is one thing I would like to confirm with you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
See~? Even Teacher has
a bone to pick with Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, is that so... Hey, Vodka-san.
About that matter from before, have you had a chance to think about it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you mean the interview?
But that was—

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it amazing! 'The rising star about to debut! The number one most anticipated Umamusume!'
That's what they said to me, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: In that case, I'll definitely pass.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't even debuted yet!
I don't wanna show myself looking half-baked and lame!"

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Geez! Come on, Vodka!
Just hear them out for a moment!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
…………The Umamusume with the highest expectations.
Not me, but her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: N-No. There's no way—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer?! What are you doing here...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "Don't just give me 'Here I am!!' You dummy!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm... I just heard someone yelling at the top of their lungs,
but... could that be Scarlet...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A-As if that could happen♪ Ufufu!
Trainer, let's hurry to the room♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... Thanks to you, Scarlet's 'model student' reputation
was almost completely ruined..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! An apology won't cut it!
You'd better reflect on what you did!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...And? Since you came all the way to get me,
I'm guessing it's finally been decided.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —The day of the debut race.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
In that case, from today on, we both give it our all.
No holding back whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
First place belongs to me.
I'm not giving it up to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...You'd better understand what your job is, too.
You're my trainer, after all—
choice_data_list: I will make you the number one Umamusume, without a doubt.
I will definitely make you the number one Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer.
Let us go show them who truly stands at the top.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Interviews" this, "promising Umamusume" that!
*I'm* the most amazing Umamusume around, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began our days together with Daiwa Scarlet,
striving to become the "Number One Horse Girl"!
